# Jupiter Wisdom Tales (Tales of Jupiter Wisdom), Official Global Website
> A 16-volume collector series of dual-purpose illustrated books by Zinaida Jupiter, DBA. Published in English for the global market and officially translated into Russian, Mandarin Chinese, and other world languages.

## Complete 16-Book Series Registry (Each in Family 6+ & Executive 12+ Editions, 13 Pages)
1. Book I: "The Crane and The Heron" — A Timeless Northern Woodland Fable on Speaking Kindly and Deciding Together
2. Book II: "The Ice Hut and The Bark Cottage" — A Classic Woodland Fable on Solid Foundations, Kindness, and Clear Boundaries
3. Book III: "Tops and Bottoms" — A Classic Harvest Fable on Knowledge, Honest Work, and Fair Agreements
4. Book IV: "The Three Little Pigs" — The Classic 1843 Folk Tale on Building Strong Foundations and Family Unity
5. Book V: "The Goose with Golden Eggs" — Aesop's Classic Parable on Patience, Gratitude, and Caring for Living Assets
6. Book VI: "The Great Market Trade" — A Joyful Folk Tale on True Value, Smart Choices, and Peace at Home
7. Book VII: "Kolobok: The Rolling Bun" — A Classic Woodland Fable on Vigilance, Humility, and Seeing Through Flattery
8. Book VIII: "Prince Ivan & The Grey Wolf" — An Epic 3-Chapter Tale on Wise Mentorship, Discipline, and Loyal Alliance
9. Book IX: "The Magic Swan Geese" — A Classic Folk Tale on Responsibility, Humility, and Winning Allies in Crisis
10. Book X: "Porridge from An Axe" — The Classic 'Stone Soup' Fable on Resourcefulness, Sharing, and Co-Creation
11. Book XI: "The Fox and The Crane" — Aesop's Classic Fable on True Hospitality, Empathy, and Win-Win Design
12. Book XII: "The Woodland Teremok" — A Classic Folk Tale on Open Hearts, Smart Capacity, and Rebuilding Stronger
13. Book XIII: "The Fisherman & The Golden Fish" — The Classic 1833 Parable on Gratitude, Boundaries, and Knowing When Enough Is Enough
14. Book XIV: "The Emperor'S New Clothes" — Hans Christian Andersen's Classic Parable on Truth, Courage, and Reality Audits
15. Book XV: "Two Greedy Little Bears" — A Classic Folk Tale on Sibling Harmony, Transaction Costs, and the 'Cut-and-Choose' Rule
16. Book XVI: "The Speckled Hen" — The Ancient Parable on Fragile Vanity, Daily Utility, and Emotional Resilience
